cards.title: Three questions to settle first
cards.purpose: Helps the reader see the three first questions at a glance.
cards.placement: Goes in section 1, after the numbered list.
cards.design_brief: A plain checklist picture with three empty rows, drawn as simple flat shapes in calm navy with orange accents on a light background. Each row has a small empty box on the left and a long blank bar on the right, with clear empty space on the right of each row where the words will go. Mood: calm, tidy and reassuring, like a well-organized folder.
cards.generation_prompt: A plain checklist graphic with three empty rows, flat simple shapes in calm navy with orange accents on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space on the right of each row where the words will go. Calm, reassuring mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image
cards.alt_text: A checklist of three first questions: authority to sign, what is owed, what the house needs.

cards.title: The law's list and the condition it sets
cards.purpose: Shows the law's list of conditions next to the one threshold that decides whether they count.
cards.placement: Goes in section 2, right after the opening paragraph.
cards.design_brief: Two parts side by side. On the left, a stack of three plain horizontal bars. On the right, one larger rounded panel that feels like the main point, with generous room inside for a long sentence. Flat simple shapes in navy with orange accents on a light background. Leave clear empty space inside the bars and the panel where the words will go. Mood: careful and reassuring.
cards.generation_prompt: A calm two-part layout: on the left a simple stack of three plain horizontal bars, on the right one larger rounded panel, flat shapes in navy with orange accents on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space inside the bars and the panel where the words will go. Reassuring, careful mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image

text_overlay.text: California's Health and Safety Code lists conditions that can make a building substandard, such as junk and debris that are fire, health or safety hazards.
The law counts them only when they endanger life, limb, health, property, safety or welfare.

cards.alt_text: A list of conditions on the left and, on the right, the condition that must be met for them to count.

cards.title: Your options at a glance
cards.purpose: Shows the three routes side by side so the reader sees they have a choice, not a single path.
cards.placement: Goes in section 3, after the bulleted list.
cards.design_brief: A simple flow picture: one starting shape on the left that branches into three equal rounded boxes on the right, joined by thin orange arrows. Flat shapes in navy on a light background, with orange used only for the arrows. Leave clear empty space inside the start shape and every box where the words will go. Mood: calm and balanced, showing that there is a choice.
cards.generation_prompt: A simple flow diagram with one starting shape on the left that branches into three equal rounded boxes on the right, flat shapes in navy with orange arrows on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space inside every box and the start shape where the words will go. Calm, balanced mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image
cards.alt_text: One starting point leading to three options: keep the house, clear it first, sell it as it is.
